microsoft-365-e7.title: Microsoft 365 E7 for Enterprise – Microsoft
microsoft-365-e7.notes: Microsoft 365 E7 is an enterprise plan that bundles Microsoft 365 E5, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Agent 365 and the Microsoft Entra Suite on one platform. The stated aim is to protect employees and their AI agents while scaling AI across a workforce without weakening security or compliance. Agent 365 acts as a control plane for managing and securing agents across Microsoft 365 and third-party services, while the Entra Suite unifies identity, security and network access. The plan also covers the Office apps, Exchange, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams Phone, Windows 11 Enterprise, Intune and Windows 365 Cloud PCs. On the AI side it includes Copilot in apps, AI chat, agents and agent building with Copilot Studio, and the security and compliance stack includes Defender, Purview and Security Copilot. It is sold in a variant with Teams and one without, both billed per user per month with an annual commitment, and purchase goes through sales. Agents require an Azure subscription that is billed by usage, some Teams-integrated features need a Teams license, and availability can vary by market and license.

microsoft-applied-skills.title: Microsoft Applied Skills – Microsoft Learn
microsoft-applied-skills.notes: Microsoft Applied Skills are credentials that show a person can use Microsoft technologies in realistic AI and cloud scenarios. They are earned by completing interactive, lab-based tasks that mirror real work, so the assessment is hands-on rather than a multiple-choice exam. The program is framed as prepare, earn and share, and learners can work at their own pace and schedule. Credentials are grouped by role, such as AI engineer, Azure administrator, security engineer, data engineer and Power Platform functional consultant. Newer ones cover business use of Microsoft 365 Copilot as well as technical topics like Copilot Studio and Foundry. The intended audience includes IT professionals, business professionals, developers, students, educators and career changers. People use the credentials to prove practical skills for job applications or project assignments, and the page points to guidance on choosing between Applied Skills and Microsoft Certifications. The page is a marketing overview and does not state fees, passing scores or how long a credential stays valid.

microsoft-entra-tenant-governance.title: What is Microsoft Entra Tenant Governance? – Microsoft Learn
microsoft-entra-tenant-governance.notes: Microsoft Entra Tenant Governance gives an organization visibility across all of its tenants and helps keep them aligned with security and compliance requirements. Large organizations often run several tenants, for example after mergers, for sensitive workloads or for testing, and unmanaged shadow IT tenants are hard to audit. The capability detects related tenants through B2B access, multitenant applications and shared billing accounts. Governance relationships add invitation and approval workflows for cross-tenant administrator access based on least privilege, with policy templates. Configuration management defines baselines in a standard JSON format, runs monitors that report drift against the desired state, and takes snapshots of current settings across services such as Entra, Intune, Exchange Online, Teams, Purview and Defender. A resource policy feature, still in preview, evaluates Microsoft Graph requests against policies and can block non-compliant changes, but it only acts at request time and does not fix existing resources. Secure tenant creation can attach a governance relationship automatically to new tenants. The service comes in Basic and Premium tiers, and licensing details are documented separately.

microsoft-graph-activity-logs.title: Access Microsoft Graph activity logs for tenant monitoring – Microsoft Learn
microsoft-graph-activity-logs.notes: Microsoft Graph activity logs form an audit trail of the HTTP requests that the Microsoft Graph service receives and processes for a tenant. Tenant administrators turn them on through diagnostic settings in Azure Monitor and send them to a Log Analytics workspace, an Azure storage account or an Event Hubs namespace for streaming to external SIEM tools. The logs capture traffic from line-of-business apps, API clients, SDKs, AI clients and Microsoft apps such as Outlook and Teams. Data lands in the MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs table, with fields for the app and user identity, request URI and method, response status, scopes and roles, client authentication method and conditional access status. Typical uses include tracing what an app did, investigating activity of a compromised account, reviewing unexpected privileged application permissions and spotting unusual call volumes. Setup requires a Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2 license, a supported admin role such as Security Administrator, and an Azure subscription with a destination. Only activity in the resource tenant is recorded, diagnostic settings cannot filter the data, and secrets must not be stored in directory attributes because request URIs are logged.

office-scripts.title: Office Scripts in Excel – Microsoft Learn
office-scripts.notes: Office Scripts let people automate everyday tasks in Excel by recording manual steps and replaying them as reusable scripts. The Action Recorder captures actions such as editing cells, formatting and creating tables and saves them as a script. A Copy as code option turns recorded actions into script code without saving the whole script. The Code Editor is used to refine recorded or newly written scripts, adding logic such as conditions and loops or functions that the Excel interface does not offer directly. Scripts can be called from Power Automate flows so they run outside the workbook, for example in response to emails or on a schedule. A script can be attached to a workbook so teammates with access can see and run it, and scripts are stored in OneDrive. The example on the page is a daily CSV clean-up that removes unneeded columns, formats a table, adds formulas and builds a PivotTable in a new worksheet. The page notes that scheduling from within Excel is temporarily disabled, with Power Automate named as the alternative, and it leaves licensing details to other articles.

onecopy.title: OneLake, the OneDrive for data – Microsoft Fabric – Microsoft Learn
onecopy.notes: OneLake is the unified data lake that comes automatically with every Microsoft Fabric tenant, and one OneLake exists per tenant. It builds on Azure Data Lake Storage and stores tables in open formats such as Delta Parquet or Iceberg. The one copy idea is that all Fabric analytics engines work directly on the data in OneLake, so data does not have to be copied to be used by another engine or combined with other sources. A table created with T-SQL can be read by Spark without special connectors or exports, and Power BI reports can read the data directly through Direct Lake. Shortcuts act as references to data stored elsewhere, such as other workspaces, Azure storage, Amazon S3 or Dataverse, so teams share data without duplicating it. Security roles apply consistently at folder, table, row and column level across SQL, Spark and Power BI. There are limits: a shortcut depends on the availability of its source, database mirroring does create a copy, and the principle describes a logical copy, since physical redundancy still exists.
